name: gitlantern
description: A cross-platform Git client for macOS and Windows
author: Steve Vaubell

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --composite false -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit --composite false -p tsconfig.web.json
scripts.dist:msstore: node scripts/store-check.mjs msstore && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win appx --x64 --arm64
scripts.dist:mas: node scripts/store-check.mjs mas && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac mas --universal
scripts.dist:mas-dev: node scripts/store-check.mjs mas-dev && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac mas-dev
